title: spec pin: adopt the SemVer 2.0.0 version canon — PackageFormDialog's hand-copied VERSION_RE and the verbatim help-text pin break when objectstack#18697 lands
body:
~~Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#18697~~ — **void**. It is a cycle: objectstack#18697 waits for this card. Struck by the `domain:spec` @ objectui seat per triage verdict 5817640535.

Filed by the `domain:spec` seat 5 of `objectstack-ai/objectstack` (`session_01Sfe5YjBLwB9J3y8fvm2xq1`) at the ACCEPT of PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#19637, exactly as director ruling `5749112309` (decision batch #194 item 2, letter **A**, maintainer 「同意」) directs: 「the objectui card is filed by the spec seat at that PR's ACCEPT」.

## What changed upstream

`@objectstack/spec` now has ONE grammar for "the version of a package or plugin" — `SEMVER_2_0_0_VERSION_PATTERN`, semver.org's own expression — and all nine in-repo carriers reference it. Three predecessor constants (`MAJOR_MINOR_PATCH_VERSION_PATTERN`, `SEMVER_SHAPED_VERSION_PATTERN`, `SEMVER_SHAPED_LOWERCASE_VERSION_PATTERN`) are **retired**, not aliased.

objectui is the **tenth carrier** and the only one outside that repository.

## The three sites, read first-hand in this checkout (⛔ not relayed)

| site | reading |
|:--|:--|
| `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackageFormDialog.tsx:39` | `const VERSION_RE = /^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/;` — a hand-copied strict grammar. After the upstream change it **refuses `2.0.0-beta.1`, which the platform now accepts**, so the dialog is stricter than the contract it is a form for. Used at `:227` for `versionOk`. |
| `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackageFormDialog.helpTextI18n.test.tsx:63` | `expect(screen.getByText('Package version (semantic versioning)')).toBeInTheDocument();` — pins the upstream `.describe()` string **VERBATIM**. |
| `package-schema.ts` | projects `ManifestSchema` through `z.toJSONSchema(...)`, so it carries whatever grammar upstream declares. Named for completeness; ⛔ not re-read line-by-line in this act. |

⚠️ The upstream describe string changes from `Package version (semantic versioning)` to `Package version (SemVer 2.0.0 — e.g. 1.2.3, 2.0.0-beta.1, 1.0.0+20230101)`. ⇒ the pin at `:63` **fails by construction** the moment this repo consumes the new spec.

## Why this is urgent rather than routine

`objectstack`'s **Console Pin Gate** builds objectui at `.objectui-sha` against that tree. Measured: the gate is **skipped on pull requests** but **runs and passes on `main`** (success on the three most recent main commits). ⇒ if objectstack#19637 lands before this card, that gate goes **red on `main`**, which is shared damage rather than one PR's problem.

**This is why objectstack#19637 is being held as a draft and ⛔ NOT enqueued**, even though it is green and its contract review PASSed. The ordering question belongs to the maintainers of both repos.

## One executable criterion

```
# after this card lands, in objectui:
grep -n "VERSION_RE" packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackageFormDialog.tsx
#   => imports the canon from @objectstack/spec, no local literal
grep -n "semantic versioning" packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackageFormDialog.helpTextI18n.test.tsx
#   => 0 hits; the assertion reads the new string
```

The ruling's phase-1 shape applies here too: **import the canon rather than re-spelling it** — `import { SEMVER_2_0_0_VERSION_PATTERN } from '@objectstack/spec/kernel'` — so this site cannot drift again. The help-text assertion should follow the upstream string rather than restate it, if this repo has a mechanism for that; if it does not, restating it is acceptable and the drift is what this card exists to end.

⛔ This card is **not** graded or routed by the filing seat — `domain:*` and priority are objectui triage's production. ⛔ No upstream state was written from here.
